title: DeckConfigDocument
description: A merged deck config document containing projected estate inventory and presentation data.

hosts.description: Declared hosts; absent is equivalent to an empty array.

services.description: Declared services; absent is equivalent to an empty array.

groups.description: Portal layout groups; absent is equivalent to an empty array.

sources.description: Document and configuration source declarations; absent is equivalent to an empty array.

integrations.description: External tool integrations; absent is equivalent to an empty array.

llmUsage.description: Optional subscription plan-usage limits; absent disables the feature.

actions.description: Governed actions; absent is equivalent to an empty array.

agents.description: Reserved agent slots; absent is equivalent to an empty array.

name.description: Human-readable estate name shown in the shell header.

domains.description: Per-network domain suffixes keyed by network label.

additionalProperties.description: A domain suffix for the network named by the key.

timezone.description: IANA timezone name used by consumers for display.

freshness.description: Freshness defaults consumers use to derive staleness.

snapshotStaleAfter.description: ISO-8601 duration after which a snapshot is considered stale.

name.description: Host name, unique across the config.

kind.description: What kind of host this is.

purpose.description: One-line statement of what the host is for.

status.description: Declared lifecycle status rather than observed state.

hypervisor.description: Name of the host that runs this guest; required with vmid.

vmid.description: Numeric guest id on its hypervisor; required with hypervisor.

access.description: Reachability and collection-method summary, never credentials.

managedConfigs.description: Live config files mapped to source-of-truth files.

stacksRoot.description: Filesystem root under which container stacks live.

secrets.description: Opaque secret references this host depends on.

links.description: Presentation links shown on the host card.

bindings.description: Live-provider bindings keyed by provider kind.

hidden.description: Hide this host from default views without affecting validation.

network.description: Network label for this address (e.g. lan, tailnet). An open label — the same vocabulary Estate.domains keys off.

primary.description: Whether this is the host's primary address on that network.

reachable.description: Whether the host is expected to be reachable.

port.description: Network port used by the access method.

user.description: Non-secret user name used for access.

expected.description: Whether this entity is expected to be backed up.

host.description: Name of the host this service runs on.

kind.description: What kind of service this is.

purpose.description: One-line statement of what the service is for.

status.description: Declared lifecycle status rather than observed state.

stack.description: Stack directory when it differs from the service name.

secrets.description: Opaque secret references this service depends on.

links.description: Presentation links shown on the service card.

bindings.description: Live-provider bindings keyed by provider kind.

hidden.description: Hide this service from default views without affecting validation.

Bindings.title: Bindings
Bindings.description: Provider-defined live bindings keyed by provider kind.

id.description: Group id, unique across the groups tree.

title.description: Group heading shown in the portal.

order.description: Optional sort key among sibling groups.

icon.description: Optional icon token for the group heading.

items.description: Ordered service, link, or subgroup items.

type.description: Discriminator for a declared service reference.

host.description: Host name of the referenced service.

name.description: Service name on the referenced host.

type.description: Discriminator for a plain external link.

id.description: Subgroup id, unique across the groups tree.

order.description: Optional sort key among sibling items.

items.description: Service or link items only; nested subgroups are forbidden.

GroupItem.title: GroupItem
GroupItem.description: A service reference, plain link, or one-level subgroup.

path.description: Filesystem path to the source root.

service.description: Optional owning service name on that host.

credentialEnv.description: Environment variable name holding a credential, never its value.

baseUrl.description: Base URL of the integrated tool.

deepLink.description: Optional deep-link template into the tool.

credentialEnv.description: Environment variable name holding a credential, never its value.

LlmUsage.title: LlmUsage
LlmUsage.description: Subscription plan-usage limits for Claude Code and Codex accounts.

claude.description: Claude Code (Claude.ai Pro/Max) usage; presence enables the Claude panel.

credentialsFile.description: Read-only path to a Claude Code .credentials.json; enables the OAuth usage backfill. Never written or refreshed by deck.

transcriptsDir.description: Optional read-only path to a Claude Code projects directory for the token-count transcript scan.

statusLine.description: statusLine hook ingest; the route exists only when the credential is set.

credentialEnv.description: Environment variable name holding the ingest bearer token, never its value.

activeInterval.description: ISO-8601 OAuth poll interval while a session is active; clamped to at least PT2M.

idleInterval.description: ISO-8601 OAuth poll interval while idle; clamped to at least PT2M.

codex.description: Codex (ChatGPT subscription) usage; presence enables the Codex panel.

codexHome.description: Read-write CODEX_HOME holding auth.json (the app-server refreshes it); mount the host's ~/.codex at the same path so its absolute symlinks resolve.

command.description: Codex executable path as deck sees it; defaults to codex on PATH. The deck image ships no codex: mount the host's Linux binary and point this at it.

rolloutDir.description: Optional rollout sessions directory; defaults to <codexHome>/sessions.

thresholds.description: Percent-used bands for warn and danger tones.

warn.description: Percent used at which a bar turns warn; default 75.

danger.description: Percent used at which a bar turns danger; default 90.

idlePause.description: ISO-8601 duration without a viewer after which upstream polling pauses; default PT5M.

runner.description: Estate-side runner or playbook name, never a command.

params.description: Typed parameters accepted by the runner.

service.description: Optional target service name on that host.

name.description: Parameter name, unique within the action.

required.description: Whether the parameter must be supplied.

default.description: Optional default value matching the declared type.

values.description: Allowed values when the type is enum.

id.description: Reserved agent id, unique across agents.

SecretRef.title: SecretRef
SecretRef.description: An opaque secret reference id, never a secret value.
